lines: Open events are for every Albert School student — no membership needed.
Tournaments and Build Lab are for members.
Becoming one is a tick on a form.

join.title: Come once. Stay if it is useful.
join.lede: Two ways in. Both take a minute.
join.way1Body: The form has a box that says “join Albert L.I.G.H.T.”. Tick it, and you are a member.
join.way2Title: Or scan the code on the day
join.way2Body: There is a QR code at every event for joining on the spot.
join.opensBody: Vibe coding tournaments and Build Lab. Workshops, crash courses and the big open events are for every Albert School student, member or not.
join.beforeBody: Twenty minutes at home, so the room is spent building.

form.notOn: Sign-ups are not open yet. The date is firm: add it to your calendar, and come back here to put your name down.
form.noJs: The sign-up form needs JavaScript. The date is firm, and the calendar links on this page work without it.
form.doneNoCap: No cap on this one. See you there.
form.doneCalendar: Put it in your calendar so you do not have to remember it.
form.name: Full name
form.notePlaceholderCompete: Who you are coming with, or that you need a team.
form.notePlaceholder: What you want to get out of it, or who you want to meet.
form.joinBox: I want to join Albert L.I.G.H.T. (free)
form.privacy: We keep your name and email to know who is coming, and we delete the list a month after the event. We never pass it on. Write to us and we remove you the same day.
form.errFull: This one is full. Write to us and we will tell you when the next date opens.
form.errClosed: Sign-ups for this date are closed.
form.errUnknown: Sign-ups are not open yet for this date.
form.errCheck: Check the name and the email, one of the two was not accepted.
form.errGeneric: That did not go through. Try again in a moment, or write to us.
